first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making simplification the most directly relevant intervention. I will verify the archived evidence for shortening onboarding and signup-field reduction because their durability, segment scope, and impact on qualified long-term revenue are consequential but not established here. A guarded test can measure completion, activation, and downstream qualified revenue while limiting the risk of increasing low-quality signups.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding-shortening experiment because completion and activation are both declining, and the verified evidence shows a 13% completion lift, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and 3% higher 30-day retention. Measure activation, completion, time-to-value, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue. Do not make signup-field reduction the primary intervention: although it lifted SMB activation and qualified revenue, it reduced 30-day retention by 1% and has not replicated beyond SMB, creating sustainable-value risk.
